name: product-onboarding-flow
description: Use when the user asks to improve activation in the first-run experience, user onboarding flow, aha moment, product tours, checklists, empty states or onboarding drop-off. Produces activation milestones, onboarding funnel and experiments. Not for growth loops and referrals (use product-growth-engineering) or employee onboarding (use core-onboarding).
